text: At step 12000, layer-1 energy R² is 0.973 at N=64 but only 0.939 at N=128 for seed 22, while distance R² is about the same (0.958 vs 0.955). Across m2-fixed N=64/N=128 pairs, does each seed's N=128 energy (orbit-scale) deficit at layer 1 predict its force gap? That would suggest the layer-1 force read combines distance with an orbit-scale code that is weaker at fine sampling.
